decisions.reason: As the flagship organic line with several models aligned to the firm's strategic direction, its option value remains high and there is still no evidence that its value is unlikely to be realized.
The organic poultry mini salami snack remains a low-cost option in a growing organic segment with its own page, so uncertainty still favors keeping the option open.
Launched only in 2024 and building on established sausage capabilities, it is an early-stage option with low keeping costs and still unresolved market potential.
With multiple models in a new organic convenience format, it represents a small portfolio of options whose prospects are still uncertain but inexpensive to keep open.
The organic herb-coated salami is close to the established offer but still early in its launch and aligned with the organic expansion, so it should be kept open while its value resolves.
